name: Vercel CLI
description: Run the vercel CLI against exactly one Vercel project with a project-scoped token that never enters the sandbox shell or the model's context. Every command carries the agent's written justification and is human-approved by default.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.description: Project-scoped Vercel token (vcp_…) delivered by the Vercel platform teammate's provisioning flow — leave it to arrive that way, or set it by hand for a standalone install. Read only by the tool process; never exposed to the sandbox shell.

secrets.name: VERCEL_CLI_REQUIRE_APPROVAL
secrets.description: Set to 0 to let this agent run vercel commands without per-command human approval. Any other value (or leaving it unset after install) keeps the approval gate on. Ignored on an agent holding the full-account token — that agent is always gated.
